title.en: Death of Britannicus (possible poisoning by Nero)

description.sr: 55. godine umire Britanik, sin cara Klaudija i Neronov konkurent za presto; iako se pričalo da je Neron kriv za njegovu smrt, sam Neron je izgubio popularnost više zbog majke Agripine nego zbog ove smrti.
description.en: In 55 CE, Britannicus, son of Emperor Claudius and Nero's rival for the throne, died; although it was rumored that Nero was responsible for his death, Nero himself lost popularity more because of his mother Agrippina than because of this death.

events.quote: pričalo se, 55. godine umire Britanik, kao Klaudije Visin

description.sr: 18. i 19. jula 64. godine izbija veliki požar u Rimu, počevši na Aventinskom brdu, jednom od sedam brežuljaka na kojima je grad osnovan.
description.en: On July 18-19, 64 CE, the Great Fire of Rome broke out, starting on the Aventine Hill, one of the seven hills on which the city was founded.

events.quote: 18. na 19. jul 64. godine, kada izbija požar, dakle, na jednom od onih Aventin

description.sr: Sredinom 68. godine, kada se probudio i zatekao da su ga svi napustili, uključujući vernu pretorijansku gardu, Neron se, saznavši za zaveru senata i vojske protiv njega, ubija.
description.en: In mid-68 CE, waking to find that everyone had abandoned him, including the loyal Praetorian Guard, Nero, learning of the conspiracy against him by the Senate and army, took his own life.

events.quote: sredinom 68. godine, to je bio neki jun ... se Neron budi jedne noći u palati i vidi da bukvalno nema nikoga oko njega
